judged_text: The disqus import loop now fetches each thread URL remotely through TopicEmbed.import_remote with no per-thread error handling, so the first dead or malformed link (OpenURI::HTTPError/SocketError from open(url)) aborts the entire import run, and non-http links silently return nil and skip that thread's posts. An operator importing a large Disqus forum loses every thread after the first bad link in a single command run — a failure mode introduced by this diff, since the previous code created the topic without any remote fetch.

adjudication.rationale: In `lib/tasks/disqus.thor`, the import loop now calls `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], ...)` for each thread. `TopicEmbed.import_remote` does `open(url).read` (and later `Readability::Document.new(...)`) with no `rescue`, so an `OpenURI::HTTPError`, `SocketError`, etc. will raise and abort the entire Thor task run. Additionally, `TopicEmbed.import` returns `nil` unless the URL matches `^https?://`, so non-HTTP(S) `t[:link]` values will be silently skipped, unlike the previous behavior which created a topic without fetching remotely.
